versions.subject: Merge PR #4961 from @tsale - Add multiples rules and updates
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\onenote.exe'
    Image|endswith:
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\cscript.exe'
        - '\mshta.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
        - '\wscript.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '\exported\'
        - '\onenoteofflinecache_files\'
condition: selection
